product_metadata.title: MEFASO Automatic Soap Dispenser, Touchless Foaming Soap Dispenser, Stainless Steel Nozzle, Infrared Sensor, Rechargeable, for Bathroom Kitchen 8.45 oz/250ml, White
features: [0.2S Quick & Rich Foaming] - The automatic Soap Dispenser with less time to create the best result! FASO soap dispenser for the bathroom uses the latest precise infrared motion sensor and powerful pump to provide you with dream-fast foaming.
[Resource & Money Saving] - The foaming soap dispenser works well with all kinds of foaming hand liquid. The capacity counts 250ml/8.45 oz., which it can use for at least a month for a family.

[No More Drips] - The stainless steel nozzle with a sealed outlet avoids leakage onto your countertop and reduces waste. Say goodbye to the wet and messy countertop. A detachable container prevents liquid from leaking into the battery compartment and causing a mess on your countertop.

[Triple Safety Design for Long Term Using] - IPX3-waterproof grade and waterproof plug make this automatic foaming soap dispenser suitable for any wet countertop. Note: Hand sanitiser should be diluted with water before use. The ratio of hand sanitiser to water is about 1:6-1:8.

[About MEFASO] - We are committed to serving our customers with reliable products and empathetic service. Each product passed the quality inspection. You will get a 24 Months-Warranty for replacement. Please feel free to contact us if there is any problem.
